difficultyAxis: Still trivial, but with four attributes of three distinct Java types and two stories instead of one, so the per-entity and per-story loops both execute more than once.
rationale: Same shape as tier1-01 with multiplicity added on the story axis and a temporal type introduced. A generator that handles exactly one attribute type, or that emits only the first user story, still passes tier1-01 and fails here.

userStories.intent: create a tag with a label and a display colour

scenarios.then: the tag is persisted and returned with its creation timestamp

userStories.intent: read a tag that has already been created
userStories.benefit: the editor can confirm the stored display colour

scenarios.then: the tag is returned with its label and colour
